item.title: Kevin Warsh’s reluctance to signal where interest rates are headed has left the world unsure how he thinks about the economy or inflation. Fortunately, there’s a trove of evidence on exactly how he thinks.
item.description: [WSJ] As a Fed governor 15 years ago, Warsh was more worried about inflation than nearly all of his colleagues, and for years it didn’t materialize.
